tooling.generator: fgen (fuckinggen CLI, ChatGPT Images subscription backend)
tooling.generationPolicy: Every generated raster in this manifest was produced by an explicit fgen gen command with an explicit --out path. No --last/state reference was used.
tooling.optimization: Generated PNG outputs were converted with cwebp -quiet -q 84 to the served WebP paths. Transparent PNG cutouts were resized in place to 1024x1024 with macOS sips; alpha was rechecked after resizing.

agent-collage.png.prompt: One compact overlapping sticker collage icon with eight coding-agent emblems: Claude orange starburst, OpenAI white knot, Cursor black pointer, Copilot goggles face, Gemini gradient star, OpenCode black brackets, Cline blue robot, Aider green terminal chevron. All eight emblems cluster tightly into ONE circular pile of dimensional die-cut stickers, overlap slightly, white sticker edges, bright colors, readable at small size. No grid. No text or names. True transparent alpha background with nothing outside silhouette. Square.
agent-collage.png.generationEvidence: FGEN saved 1662707 bytes; 1254x1254 RGBA source contained 494632 fully transparent pixels. Resized to 800x800 with Pillow LANCZOS and saved as PNG.

human-cutout.png.prompt: Transparent isolated square portrait of an adult human face only, a comically warped editorial caricature with stretched cheeks, one oversized surprised eye, tiny pursed mouth, asymmetrical ears, and delightfully uncanny expression; vivid cobalt blue, acid chartreuse, coral, and warm skin tones; high-detail painterly digital illustration with surreal rubbery distortion; head and neck fully inside frame; true transparent alpha around the silhouette; no checkerboard painted into background; no text, no logo, no watermark, no minors, no nudity.
human-cutout.png.generationEvidence: fgen JSON summary saved /Users/volodymurvasualkiw/GSpace/Opensource/WTF/WTFIS-CLI/public/assets/fgen/human-cutout.png (2000844 bytes before resize).

hero-generated.webp.prompt: Vivid surreal editorial hero image for an experimental AI command-line website: a luminous electric-blue terminal window floating in a paper-white void, erupting into acid-chartreuse ribbons, molten orange sparks, impossible magenta geometry, tiny pixel stars and a humorous off-kilter perspective; crisp graphic-design composition, high contrast, energetic but clean, square artwork with no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no border.
hero-generated.webp.command: fgen gen <prompt> --out public/assets/fgen/hero-generated.png --quality high --size 1024x1024 --timeout 300 --json; cwebp -quiet -q 84 hero-generated.png -o hero-generated.webp
hero-generated.webp.generationEvidence: fgen JSON summary saved /Users/volodymurvasualkiw/GSpace/Opensource/WTF/WTFIS-CLI/public/assets/fgen/hero-generated.png (1828643 bytes before WebP conversion).
